purpose: smaller sample of the extraction-precision-v1 development split for the live sessions of U1 to U7; scored with the labels of extraction-precision-v1 (score_positions skips labeled comments absent from a run)
selection: From data/evaluation/extraction-precision-v1/labels.jsonl, rows with split "development": per language (en, zh), ordered by the hexadecimal SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string "upgrade-samples-v1:<comment_id>", ascending, and the first ceil(n/2) taken (en 45 of 89, zh 69 of 138). Listed by language, then that order. record_id is the label comment_id; content_sha256 is copied from the label. No test-split row is read for the selection beyond its split field.
